titulo: The MacBook Air M5 is $200 off for the first time in months
cuerpo: Amazon’s October Prime Day has effectively chopped off Apple’s June price increases. Usually $1,299, the 13-inch MacBook Air with the M5 chip and 512GB of storage is on sale for $1,099 at Amazon.
